title: Government & Defense Public Sector Governance Rulepack

rules.title: Secrets Isolation & Prohibition of Hardcoded Credentials
rules.description: Secrets, API keys, passwords, and tokens must never be hardcoded in source code or configuration manifests.

rules.title: Mandatory Immutable Event Audit Logging
rules.description: All system authentication, authorization, and administrative events must be logged with correlation IDs.

rules.title: FIPS 140-3 Validated Cryptographic Algorithms
rules.description: Cryptographic operations must utilize AES-256-GCM, RSA-4096, or Ed25519; deprecated ciphers are strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Bounded Context & Zero-Trust Perimeter Isolation
rules.description: Bounded contexts must enforce strict domain isolation and disallow unauthenticated inter-service calls.

rules.title: Multi-Factor Authentication & ABAC Policy Enforcement
rules.description: User and machine access must enforce MFA and Attribute-Based Access Control policies.
